verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Logseq has its own natural-language command interface or built-in AI assistant. The local HTTP API, plugin APIs, and logseq:// protocol are developer building blocks, not the capability itself. Simple `{{query}}` syntax is structured search rather than natural-language operation, and the community mention of using Claude or Codex to edit pages is an external user-side workaround that earns no credit.
